Cyera is on a mission to protect one of the world's most valuable resources: data. Our AI-native platform gives organizations a complete view of where their data lives, how it’s used, and how to keep it safe, so they can reduce risk and unlock the full value of their data, wherever it is.

Since our founding in 2021, we’ve grown fast- Cyera-fast - securing over $1.3 billion in funding from the biggest pockets on the planet and establishing a global team. Today, Cyera is the fastest growing data security company on the planet, trusted by the Fortune 500 and beyond.

Responsibilities:

  • Direct contribution to the Cyera codebase as part of a product team.
  • Identifying, documenting, and communicating technical improvements within your area of responsibility in the team
  • Close collaboration with technical (backend, QA & infrastructure) and non-technical (product, design) roles to understand and challenge end-user requirements and ultimately translate these into practical technical
  • Participating in cross-team engineering initiatives as an individual contributor

Requirements

  • At least 4 years as a Full Stack Engineer
  • Deep knowledge of JavaScript and strong expertise in React /Vue.js or a similar stack
  • Experience in backend development languages such as Node.js, TypeScript, Java, Scala, Python, Ruby, .NET, etc., and willing to learn
  • Relevant experience working on fast-scaling and complex systems
  • Driven by impact. You are eager to create customer value

Why Join Us?

At Cyera, we care about collaboration, innovation, and agility. We take “teamwork” seriously—with our inclusive and supportive culture at the forefront—and we’re just as serious about nurturing Cyerans to grow, both personally and professionally.

Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.

We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Technical Architect
description:
As a Salesforce Technical Architect Comunications , The Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers.

You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Architecture: Lead technical design sessions and translate complex business requirements into well-architected solutions that leverage the Salesforce platform and its various products, SFI Industries, APEX and Omnistudio
  • Technical Leadership: You might lead a team of developers guiding them though the best practices, providing them an end to end vision, value driven scalable solutions, your solutions include but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products, APIs, Lightning Experience & Component development, Apex/Visualforce, mobile development technologies, and integration middleware/ETL technologies.
  • Release & DevOps Management: Lead/manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migrations. You will contribute to establish and manage DevOps strategies, including CI/CD pipelines, version control (GIT ), and environment management for large-scale implementations.
  • Project Collaboration: Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, set expectations, and identify gaps between their current and desired states. You will also participate in pre-sales activities such as discovery sessions and Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development.
  • System Integration: Architect and manage integrations with external systems via APIs and ETL technologies. You should have a strong background in designing and building large web-based systems.
  • Problem-Solving: Proactively debug and resolve complex technical issues as they arise, applying a deep understanding of the project and its components.
  • Salesforce Liaison: Work with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations and ensure solutions align with platform best practices.
  • Travel: Be prepared for travel to client sites, averaging approximately 50% of the time, to collaborate effectively with global teams and stakeholders.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 9+ years of experience as a technical architect, with at least 6+ years on the Salesforce platform.
  • Platform Expertise: Expert-level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Analytics, and Experience Clouds, with OmniStudio and SFI knowledge being a plus.
  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of systems architecture, key design and integration patterns, and best practices for managing large data volumes. You should also be familiar with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth ).
  • Development Background: Strong background in designing and developing large web-based systems, including a comprehensive understanding of the full software product lifecycle.
  • DevOps & Release Management: Experience with environment management, release management, code versioning, and deployment methodologies.
  • Security & Data: Familiarity with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL ) and data sharing/visibility models.
  • Soft Skills: Be a proactive and self-managed professional with the ability to challenge the status quo and propose creative yet well-thought-out solutions.
  • Required Certifications (3 or more):
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified App Builder
    • Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified Administrator / Advanced Administrator
    • Salesforce Certified Omnistudio Developer
    • Salesforce Certified Application Architect
    • Salesforce Certified System Architect
  • English proficient

Nice to Have Skills

  • Prior experience in the Communications Cloud, Media Cloud salesforce industries.
  • Certifications: Active Salesforce certifications or the ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire. Candidates with the Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials are highly desirable.

  • Consolidar informações e preparar materiais para o Demand Review Meeting.
  • Manter registro formal de premissas, riscos e decisões tomadas.
  • Suportar auditorias e revisões de governança sobre o processo de S&OP.

  • Ensino Superior Completo Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Sistema de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Noções de finanças e custos operacionais e gestão de estoque.

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar. Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL ! Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de colaboradores pertencentes a pelo menos um grupo minorizado. Contamos com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Você se diferenciará se possuir:

Informações adicionais

  • São ágeis no atendimento das demandas do parceiro, facilitando a venda de seguros e previdência;

title: Director, Client Results
description:
Director, Client Results

Director, Client Results

This position will provide leadership and direction for the day-to-day operations of account(s). The Client Results Account Director is responsible for overall operations and operational performance.

The Purpose of Your Role

Responsible for management and coordination of various support functions and activities for accounts. Client Results Director will develop, initiate, and determine performance strategies to enhance execution to maximize results. He / she will work cross-functionally to create, implement, and optimize all necessary support initiatives, identify opportunities. Leadership will need to be tactical with a key emphasis on maximizing KPI, customer care, quality assurance, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, and training.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of work experience required
  • 10 years of contact center/BPO experience
  • 5 years prior multi-level management experience
  • Proven demonstrable track record of success
  • Team player able to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills in a team environment
  • Experience with interacting and influencing clients’ outcomes
  • Executive Presence
  • Strong Organizational, multi-tasking, time management skills
  • Travel up to 25% when it’s safe to travel

The Competencies You Bring

Strategic Thinking, P&L Ownership, Dealing with Ambiguity, Decision Making, Negotiating, Results Orientation

The Value You Deliver

Development and Execution of Strategic Account Plan

  • Responsible for overall success of program(s) and account health
  • Define and manage metrics, ensure customer satisfaction, and report statistical performance levels to appropriate groups
  • Escalation point of contact for Client contacts
  • Develop customer communication strategies
    • Establish and communicate the service standards to the operations team so that quality customer satisfaction is achieved
    • Develop strong Client partnerships
  • Account Plans
    • Build relationships at all levels
      • Ensure multi-level coverage
    • Strategize the planning, developing, and directing of the customer service program
  • Growth and Profitability Strategies
    • Coordinate analytic, strategic, and technical resources to meet client expectations and ensure satisfaction
    • Foster and create business innovation to drive increased performance and adoption
    • Lead multiple projects at once and ensure strong integration across the organization
    • Ensure Managers and Agent Results Advocates are trained on all aspects of platforms and reporting, which will require research tools, as well as excellent writing and presentation skills

Responsible for account P&L

  • Entire book of business and individual accounts
  • Identify additional revenue streams within install base

Promote active agent engagement and advancement

  • Attrition rates, incentives and rewards, Statement of Work adherence, quality, communication
  • Implement performance optimization strategies to further improve agent productivity and performance

Business Calibration

  • Drive cross-functional calibration with support functions and teams, e.g. (Workforce Management, Professional Services, Talent Acquisition and Onboarding)
  • Regular touch points with Clients, Directors, Managers, Agent Results Advocates & Agents
  • Manage up to VP and Leadership
  • Create an effective process and information flow between Client Results Team and Cross Functional Teams

Employee Management

  • Day-to-day management of resources, including sourcing, coaching, performance management and employee development
  • Responsible for succession planning
  • Foster a productive and empowering work environment
  • Mentor and develop his/her team and direct them in finding creative solutions for both Client and internal challenges, foster knowledge-sharing across all verticals internally to ensure collaborative and informed work
  • Provide team with necessary tools and training to improve core expertise and continued career growth

Budget Support

  • Execute against established annual department budget to attain business goals with operational stability

Additional Sr Director Requirements

The Senior Director of Client Results is responsible for overall operations and operational performance. The Senior Director will be the senior point of contact for day-to-day management of the business; the ability to offer solutions and new ideas to promote program success, revenue growth, and profitability. He/she will be responsible for overseeing the management and coordination of various support functions and activities for accounts. The Senior Client Results Director will direct and supervise the development and execution of performance strategies to maximize results.

  • 6 years prior multi-level management experience

Development and Execution of Strategic Account Plan

  • Perform senior-level Client negotiation and management skills, with clear and substantive speaking, writing, and presentation skills
  • Develop customer communication strategies
    • Senior point of contact for senior Client contacts and escalations
  • Develop Trusted Adviser partnerships at the senior-level
  • Account Plans
    • Direct and supervise initiatives and deliverables in Account Plans
  • Growth and Profitability Strategies
    • Direct analytic, strategic and technical resources to meet client expectations and ensure satisfaction
    • Oversee multiple projects at once and ensure strong integration across the organization
    • Ensure Directors and Managers are trained on all aspects of applications and reporting; which will require research tools, as well as excellent writing and presentation skills

Promote active agent engagement and advancement

  • Oversee attrition rates, incentives and rewards, Statement of Work adherence, quality, communication
  • Direct performance optimization strategies to further improve agent productivity and performance

Business Calibration

  • Serve as Client Results advocate and liaison for company-wide projects and initiatives

Employee Management

  • Developing bench strength within the team directly and by creating a culture of professional development
  • Responsible for succession planning with Directors and Managers, and oversee succession planning for Agent Results Advocates
  • Create an effective process and information flow between Directors and Managers
  • Demonstrates additional competencies Business Acumen, External (Strategic) Awareness & Organizational Awareness

About Liveops

Liveops is a virtual call center offering an on-demand skilled workforce of onshore virtual agents for all customer service and sales needs.

With more than 20 years of experience offering flexibility, scalable talent and meaningful work, Liveops has been improving the lives of its agents, clients, and employees by creating endless opportunity. Our virtual-flex model has enabled more than 400 organizations across service industries including retail, healthcare, insurance, tax, telecom, and government to trust Liveops to deliver a fully scalable enterprise workforce, with faster program readiness, increased revenue, and greater customer satisfaction scores than traditional call centers.

Liveops exists to improve the lives of our agents, clients and employees. As a Liveops employee, you’re part of a purpose-driven culture that values curiosity, collaboration, and results. We encourage diverse perspectives to create better outcomes, celebrate initiative, and build relationships based on trust and transparency. We offer outstanding benefits including insurance, 401k match and a flexible vacation plan.

Eligibility Requirements

Legal authorization is required to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future.

title: Country Manager - Brazil
description:
Overview

Country Manager - Brazil role at Bitso Brasil .

As Bitso’s Country Manager for Brazil, you will be the face of our business in one of the most important markets in Latin America. This role is at the heart of Bitso’s mission: making crypto useful and accessible to millions of people. You will ensure our global strategies are adapted to local needs, lead regulatory and corporate affairs, build relationships with customers and partners, and help drive business growth. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of the crypto ecosystem in Brazil, working with a high-impact team across Latin America.

What You Will Do

  • Act as Bitso’s primary spokesperson in Brazil with media, regulators, clients, partners, and the community.
  • Lead market intelligence efforts, providing ongoing insights about customer behavior, competitors, regulation, and the economy.
  • Translate local insights into actionable go-to-market strategies in close collaboration with Bitso’s global Retail and Business teams.
  • Represent Bitso before regulators and serve as legal representative for regulated entities in Brazil.
  • Build strong relationships with government authorities, regulators, and industry associations.
  • Champion customer needs locally, ensuring Bitso’s global product suite delivers a seamless and relevant experience for Brazilian users.
  • Support Bitso Business (B2B) and Retail growth by engaging with strategic clients, partners, and influencers.
  • Drive community engagement by collaborating with Marketing and Comms teams to design and execute local events and campaigns.
  • Actively contribute to regional and global planning, ensuring Brazil’s perspective and needs are included in company-wide strategies.

Who You Are

  • Proven track record in building and leading teams, preferably in fintech, crypto, payments, or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory and financial ecosystem, including relationships with regulators, banks, payment institutions, and fintech associations.
  • Experience as a public spokesperson, with demonstrable success engaging with media, regulators, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strategic business development background, with experience negotiating partnerships and supporting sales pipelines.
  • Ability to synthesize complex local trends into actionable strategies and communicate them clearly to global leadership.
  • Experience working cross-functionally in regional or global organizations, balancing local priorities with global objectives.
  • Legal and compliance awareness, able to act as legal representative with personal accountability.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (Spanish desirable).
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and passion for crypto and Bitso’s mission.

Your Team

You will collaborate closely with Bitso’s General Managers (Retail and Bitso Business), as well as global functions such as Policy, Product, Legal, Finance, and Operations.

Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products. So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

Microsoft 365 is the fastest‑growing cloud services business at Microsoft. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well‑tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self‑motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

title: Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

Join to apply for the Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer role at Microsoft

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from home. The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft. Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you!

We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond-level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up-to-date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high-scale, low-latency, always-on, and cost-effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large-scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well-tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in an object-oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well-tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with applicable law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Creative Director
description:
Overview

Job Title: Creative Director (Marketing Agency)

Type: Full Time Remote

Working Hours: Mondays - Fridays 9:00 am - 5:00 pm CST

Compensation: $3000 - $3800 USD (based on experience)

Location: LATAM (All locations - remote)

About The Company
Our client is a dynamic digital advertising and marketing automation agency, where a consultative, hands-on approach drives exceptional results. They are experts in digital advertising and CRM, dedicated to improving our clients' return on ad spend. Working across diverse industries, they provide innovative solutions and leverage cutting-edge tools and platforms to help businesses thrive. Be part of a team that's passionate about delivering impactful marketing strategies and achieving measurable success.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled Creative Director to serve as the key creative engine supporting our agency’s diverse marketing and advertising needs. This role is ideal for a hands-on designer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and possesses the technical fluency to create highly effective content optimized for various digital platforms.

You will be responsible for conceptualizing and producing high-quality visual assets that drive engagement and conversion across all client and internal channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content & Asset Production: Paid Media Design – Design and format compelling visual content (static images, basic animations) specifically optimized for placement on major advertising channels, including Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google, and X (Twitter).
  • Short-Form Video: Produce and edit engaging short-form video content for organic and paid placement across platforms like TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Meta Reels.
  • Email Marketing: Design visually appealing and high-converting email templates and graphics for marketing automation campaigns.
  • Design Tool Mastery: Utilize tools like Canva, Figma, and Photoshop with exceptional skill to maintain brand consistency and deliver production-ready creative assets on time.

Web Design & Technical Aptitude

  • Web/Landing Page Design: Create clean, functional, and aesthetically pleasing web and landing page designs (UX/UI planning and mockups), focusing on client conversion goals. Note: Direct web development (coding) is not required, but proficiency in web development is a significant advantage.
  • Creative Optimization (Bonus Skills): Utilize familiarity with principles of SEO and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) to inform design choices, ensuring all produced content is positioned for maximum performance.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a comparable multi-client role, specifically serving the U.S. market.
  • Design Proficiency: Exceptional, proven skills in Canva, Figma, and Adobe Photoshop for both rapid content creation and polished, detailed design work.
  • Platform-Specific Design: Demonstrated understanding of the content specifications and best practices for advertising and organic placement on Meta, Google, and short-form video platforms.
  • Experience in producing and editing engaging short-form video assets.
  • Versatility: Proven ability to manage and switch contexts between high-volume ad creative, detailed email graphics, and web design projects.
  • Communication: Strong ability to take creative direction and translate marketing objectives into effective visual solutions.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience or deep technical knowledge in SEO and/or CRO.
  • Basic to advanced web development (coding) skills.
  • Up-to-date education or professional certifications in design, digital marketing, brand strategy, or digital media production.

title: Senior Information Security Engineer (GRC)
description:
Senior Information Security Engineer (GRC)

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About The Role
As an Information Security Engineer focused on Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) at Clutch, you will own and mature our trust foundation. You will operationalize our security controls, drive evidence collection and continuous monitoring, and partner with product, engineering, and business teams to reduce risk while enabling speed.

About The Team
You will join a small, high‑impact Security team that partners closely with Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, and GTM. We value outcome‑oriented builders, clear documentation, and automation over manual audits. We work in the open, do frequent retros, and iterate quickly to support a rapidly scaling fintech SaaS platform serving credit unions and their members.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Baseline our control library mapped to SOC 2, PCI DSS, and key fintech obligations. Stand up gaps and remediation owners in our ticketing system.
  • Implement lightweight evidence collection pipelines for top controls such as access reviews, backup tests, vulnerability management, and CI/CD change management.
  • Complete a security risk register refresh with likelihood and impact ratings, and publish a quarterly risk report.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Lead our next SOC 2 Type II audit cycle end‑to‑end, including auditor coordination, population requests, and walkthroughs.
  • Roll out a vendor risk management workflow integrated with procurement and Legal, including tiering, due diligence, and continuous monitoring.
  • Partner with Engineering to define secure SDLC checkpoints and automate evidence from GitHub, CI, and cloud.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Drive PCI DSS certification readiness, including SoA ownership, internal audits, and management review inputs.
  • Establish KPI/KRIs and dashboards for control effectiveness and risk trends consumed by execs and customers.
  • Mature incident response playbooks and conduct at least one cross‑functional tabletop with measurable improvements.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in GRC, security engineering, or risk management within SaaS or fintech environments.
  • Proven experience running SOC 2 Type II and working toward ISO 27001, including evidence automation and auditor interactions.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security controls across AWS, containerized workloads, and modern CI/CD.
  • Practical knowledge of secure SDLC, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and third‑party risk.
  • Ability to translate requirements into actionable, ticketed work with clear owners and due dates.
  • Excellent written communication for policies, customer questionnaires, and exec‑level reporting.
  • Nice to have: experience with privacy programs, PCI readiness, or financial services regulations; relevant certs (e.g., CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 LI/LA) are a plus.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere.
  • Unforgettable Off‑Sights: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: 20 PTO days yearly and national holidays.
  • Stock Options: Receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup: Dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget: Budget for work-related trips and co‑working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aiming to revolutionize the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. We develop software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and help them responsibly lend to over 130M Americans.

Contractor Position

This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

Application Details

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior; Employment type: Contract.

description:
Job description

Embora o carro tenha um papel fundamental na vida de muitas pessoas, só 25% da população da América Latina consegue ter acesso a ele. E foi por isso que a Kovi nasceu: para mudar essa estatística!

Acreditamos que todas as pessoas merecem ter a oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas e, em busca desse propósito, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar soluções de mobilidade acessíveis, flexíveis e simples.

Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo “pague o que usar”, compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!

O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e de aprendizado constante. #VemSerKover!

Time Kovi:

Ser Kover é sinônimo de ser super engajado quando o assunto é desafio. Amamos pessoas que se importam com outras pessoas, que tenham brilho nos olhos e vontade de sobra para mudar o mundo. Se você acredita em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover! ♥

Main responsibilities

O que buscamos?

Estamos procurando um City Manager altamente dinâmico e prático para Salvador, que seja apaixonado por mobilidade e esteja disposto a crescer conosco. Esta é uma oportunidade única para participar da expansão de nossas operações em Campinas e causar um impacto significativo no futuro da mobilidade urbana.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Manter as práticas adotadas pela matriz e replicar na nova operação.
  • Gerenciar as operações diárias, incluindo a gestão de frota, manutenção e logística.
  • Gerenciar o atendimento ao cliente com excelência e assertividade.
  • Garantir a eficiência e produtividade operacional implementando e aprimorando processos.
  • Monitorar indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs) e implementar estratégias para atingir as metas.
  • Coordenar com autoridades, administração pública e para resolver quaisquer questões operacionais.
  • Construir e manter relações com fornecedores e gerenciar o estoque de peças de reposição.
  • Entender o sobre mercado local e propor soluções que escalem e sejam sustentáveis.

Requirements and skills

  • Tenha residência e conheça a região.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Experiência comprovada em logística ou gestão de operações.
  • Habilidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas, com experiência prática e capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e análise.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Flexibilidade para se adaptar a prioridades e responsabilidades em constante mudança.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Conhecimento do mercado B2C e melhores práticas de atendimento ao cliente.

Additional information

Seguro de Vida: Para cuidarmos do nosso bem maior: nossos Kovers.

Plano de Saúde: É importante se cuidar e estar bem.

Plano Odontológico: Para você dar aquele sorrisão bonito!

Our teams emphasize growth, creativity, and the freedom to think outside the box.

About This Role

We’re looking for a Technical Product Manager with a strong analytical mindset and a proven ability to lead platform‑focused initiatives.

You’ll join one of our most strategic accounts: a fast‑scaling wellness company with a national footprint in the US. This is not a feature factory role.

You’ll be driving cross‑functional outcomes, owning platform reliability and scalability, and partnering closely with engineering, SEO, and CRO teams to deliver meaningful impact.

You’ll operate within a newly structured product org where “stability & enablement” is a core business unit — and platform work is treated as first‑class priority.

This role reports directly to internal product leadership and collaborates with senior stakeholders across engineering, data, SEO, and design.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the platform roadmap: manage initiatives related to site architecture, CMS performance, scalability, QA, and SEO foundations — ensuring readiness for 5× growth in clinics and locations.
  • Be technical and decisive: work closely with engineers to debug, unblock, and scope technical solutions.
  • Bridge the gap between messy reality and scalable execution.
  • Drive clarity and impact: translate business outcomes into clear product specs, track results, and relentlessly prioritize high‑leverage opportunities.
  • Lead discovery & validation: partner with PMs and stakeholders to validate and prioritize internal and client‑facing requests using a structured intake and scoring system.
  • Support SEO enablement: while you won’t own SEO strategy, you’ll ensure the technical platform supports the SEO team’s roadmap — including performance, schema, and scalable content rollout.
  • Own documentation & communication: write clear PRDs, surface tradeoffs, and ensure shared understanding across engineering, QA, and stakeholders.
  • Manage cross‑team dependencies: coordinate work between engineering, QA, data, and operations — ensuring blockers are addressed and initiatives stay aligned to roadmap outcomes.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years as a Product Manager, ideally with a technical or platform focus.
  • Background in engineering or strong technical fluency (e.g., able to discuss code, debug issues, or evaluate feasibility).

title: Director, Infrastructure (Software Delivery & Enablement)
description:
Overview

GitLab is an open-core software company that develops the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps Platform, used by more than 100,000 organizations. Our mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. When everyone can contribute, consumers become contributors, significantly accelerating human progress. Our platform unites teams and organizations, breaking down barriers and redefining whats possible in software development. Thanks to products like Duo Enterprise and Duo Agent Platform, customers get AI benefits at every stage of the SDLC.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Role overview

As Director, Infrastructure you will lead the modernization of GitLabs software delivery and developer experience teams, overseeing a large organization of around 60 to 80 people. You will drive the transformation of our software development lifecycle, from how developers build and test code to how customers receive and deploy GitLab, ensuring a seamless and scalable delivery across both SaaS and self-managed environments. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of our platform by consolidating delivery methods, introducing AI-driven efficiencies, and advancing the quality of GitLab. Reporting directly to our VP of Platforms, your impact in the first year will include expanding and integrating teams, modernizing engineering practices, and delivering a streamlined, high-quality software experience for our global customer base.

What youll do

  • Lead the consolidation and modernization of software delivery processes across both SaaS and self-managed GitLab products, ensuring a seamless developer-to-customer lifecycle.
  • Drive the expansion and integration of delivery teams, managing an existing organization of 60+ engineers and senior leaders to meet evolving business needs.
  • Collaborate closely with product leadership and peer directors to align delivery and quality strategies with product goals and customer requirements.
  • Own the strategy for scalable software development and deployments such as, designing new developer tooling, driving API first culture, and transitioning customers to recommended installation methods such as Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Foster cross-functional partnerships with infrastructure and development engineering teams to enhance operational stability and software reliability.
  • Measure and improve key delivery metrics to ensure high-quality, timely releases that meet customer expectations.
  • Mentor and develop senior managers and principal engineers, building a strong leadership bench to support ongoing growth and innovation.

What youll bring

  • Experience leading and managing large teams, with the ability to oversee an organization of 60 or more people, including senior managers and principal engineers.
  • Proven expertise in software delivery across both SaaS and self-managed environments, with a clear understanding of the nuances between these deployment models.
  • Demonstrated success in driving transformation initiatives, particularly evolving traditional quality engineering practices into modern developer experience and test platform approaches.
  • Strong knowledge of the full software development lifecycle, from developer workflows through to customer delivery and operational stability.
  • Background in platform engineering and infrastructure, with operational experience that informs decisions about software delivery and platform stability.
  • Ability to integrate developer experience tools with software delivery processes to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Effective collaboration skills to work cross-functionally with product leadership, peers, and direct reports in a globally distributed, asynchronous environment.
  • Openness to diverse professional backgrounds and transferable skills, valuing a broad perspective on software delivery and platform operations.

About the team

The team is responsible for the end-to-end software delivery lifecycle at GitLab, encompassing both developer experience and the delivery of the product to customers in SaaS and self-managed environments. The team operates across multiple regions with a focus on asynchronous collaboration to ensure alignment and efficiency. Their mission is to modernize and transform GitLabs development and delivery processes, ensuring the quality and scalability of what we deliver to our customers. Existing GitLab Delivery and Developer Experience teams are ready to embark on the next stage of their lifecycle, focusing on consolidating diverse delivery methods into streamlined, customer-friendly installation options while continuously improving developer tools and operational stability.

Compensation and benefits

The base salary range for this roles listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the roles base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range $194,800 — $420,000 USD

How GitLab will support you

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental leave
  • Home office support

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If youre excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Gerente Regional de Vendas – Palmas/TO
description:
Esta posição reporta para: Diretor Regional de Vendas Norte

Período de inscrição até: 22/10/2025

ATENÇÃO: É imprescindível anexar o currículo atualizado no ato da candidatura.

A Mosaic Company valoriza a diversidade, a inclusão e o desenvolvimento contínuo. Igualdade e oportunidades a todos fazem parte do dia a dia dos nossos profissionais, que encontrarão aqui a trilha ideal para desenvolver suas carreiras. Nos orgulhamos de ter o respeito como um valor. E acreditamos que a inovação acontece quando temos um ambiente cercado de diferenças em todos seus aspectos, como idade, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade, cor, deficiência ou religião.

Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Executar a estratégia de vendas no curto e médio prazo.
  • Interagir com os principais stakeholders (externos e internos), construir um relacionamento de confiança com os níveis de liderança da organização para conseguir agir como um influenciador.
  • Fornecer ao Diretor Regional informações de sua região e trabalhar muito próximo aos principais clientes para alavancar o volume de vendas e as margens.
  • Participar em conjunto com a equipe nas principais negociações, quando necessário.
  • Gestão do desenvolvimento de pessoas é uma prioridade para esta posição.

O que procuramos?

  • Superior Completo em Agronomia ou Administração.
  • Desejável pós graduação.
  • Inglês Avançado
  • Experiência com gestão de pessoas.
  • Conhecimento do mercado do arco norte (MATOPIPA)
  • Atuação prévia com orçamento de volumes da gerência, através de análise do potencial e perspectivas de mercado, garantindo a execução através do time de vendas.
  • Experiência na gestão comercial - negociação e vendas: geração de demanda e condução de trabalhos de campo (demoplots, dia de campo, palestras e treinamentos).
  • Conhecimento sólido do mercado de biológicos.
  • Conhecimento profundo em fertilidade de solo, fertilizantes solúveis e nutrição de plantas.
  • Conhecimento avançado do cenário macroeconômico e de suas influências no agronegócio.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens constantes. Devido ao alto volume de viagens, deve ter fácil acesso a aeroportos.

Qual será seu horário de trabalho?

Administrativo

Qual será seu modelo de trabalho?

Home office

O que oferecemos?

  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Remuneração Variável;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio Academia;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Programa de Assistência ao Empregado (Apoiar);
  • Programa Bem Estar (Wellness);
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida;
  • Auxílio Material Escolar;
  • Benefício para filhos de 5 a 13 anos incompletos

Sobre nós

Com a missão de ajudar o mundo a produzir os alimentos de que precisa, a Mosaic atua da mina ao campo. A empresa entrega cerca de 27,2 milhões de toneladas de fertilizantes ao ano para 40 países, sendo uma das maiores produtoras globais de fosfatados e potássio combinados.

Join to apply for the Product manager senior remoto role at Netvagas

Product Manager - Sênior (Remoto)

Você conhece a Icon? Apaixonados por pessoas e especialistas em tecnologia. Nosso trabalho é encontrar talentos e soluções sob medida para os nossos clientes.

Vem encontrar o seu projeto ideal conosco e participar da comunidade ICON!

Sobre a Vaga

Código da vaga: A

Modelo de contratação: PJ

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Manager Sênior para atuar na evolução de produtos digitais. Essa posição é estratégica e envolve atuação direta em soluções de investimento.

Se você tem perfil analítico, visão de negócio e domínio do mercado financeiro, essa é uma oportunidade para ajudar a construir produtos de alto impacto e atuar lado a lado com times de tecnologia, operações e compliance em um ambiente dinâmico e em crescimento.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e gerenciar a estratégia de produtos financeiros, com foco em investimentos (renda fixa, renda variável, fundos de investimento) e cadastro de clientes.
  • Colaborar com áreas comerciais, tecnologia, compliance e operações para garantir a entrega de produtos alinhados às necessidades do mercado e regulamentações.
  • Realizar análise de competitividade, tendências de mercado e comportamento do usuário para identificar oportunidades de inovação e melhoria.
  • Definir KPIs, monitorar performance de produtos e implementar ajustes para otimizar resultados.
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre stakeholders, traduzindo demandas técnicas e comerciais em requisitos claros para desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a excelência na experiência do cliente, desde o cadastro até a jornada de investimentos.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Conhecimento em mercado financeiro nos produtos de investimentos especialmente em projetos de carteira e/ou custódia e/ou rentabilidade.
  • Perfil analítico, orientado a dados, com capacidade de priorizar iniciativas em ambientes ágeis.
  • Habilidades de comunicação excepcionais para engajar times multidisciplinares e apresentar insights à liderança.
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de traduzir complexidade em soluções simples e escaláveis.

DESEJÁVEIS

  • Certificações como CNPI, CEA ou CPA-20.

title: Quality Issue Lead - FSP
description:
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Quality Event Assessment and Investigation

This individual will be accountable for the review and classification of submitted quality issues to ascertain if the QE threshold has been met. He or she will ensure that each submitted issue is reviewed based on the established criteria, is categorized appropriately, and completed within the required time frame to ensure that events are appropriately qualified enabling expedited investigation where necessary. This individual will also be responsible for completing the necessary documentation in the eQMS system regarding the assessment of the submitted events.

Notification to Management

This individual will be responsible for initiating appropriate escalation of Critical QEs when necessary, ensuring that management is promptly and appropriately informed of quality events. The Issue Lead will be required to assess critical issues and identify these items as appropriate for escalation to leadership via the Notification to Management process.

Root Cause Analysis / Gap Analysis / Due Diligence

Once assigned a qualified event, the Issue Lead will initiate the investigation of the event to confirm the chronology and details of the issue. This individual will also be required to apply a root cause analysis, gap analysis, and / or due diligence investigation to the case. The individual will be trained in the application of an appropriate methodology and will apply it as part of the management of the case. Investigation will include reviewing relevant SOPs and supporting documents to understand what should have happened per our documented process and identifying what did not happen per the process. In addition, the investigation will include review of relevant documentation re: the event and assembling the QE team with appropriate stakeholders (SME's, study team members, etc.) to review and confirm the details of the event

Agente de Negócios Itaú Empresas (vagas em todo o Brasil)

Quer impulsionar o crescimento do maior segmento bancário de Pessoa Jurídica do Brasil? Então, essa oportunidade de Agente de Negócios no Itaú Empresas é perfeita para você!

O que esperamos de você?

Trabalhamos com foco total no cliente. Você será fundamental na construção de relacionamentos sustentáveis com grandes e médias empresas, oferecendo soluções financeiras personalizadas alinhas às suas necessidades e participando ativamente na prospecção de novos clientes.

  • Apoiar o time de Gerentes de Negócios no atendimento dos clientes PJ (Pessoa Jurídica);
  • Apoiar o time comercial na identificação de oportunidades de negócio;
  • Acompanhar o mercado financeiro e suas tendências.
  • Desejável certificação CPA-10;
  • Ensino Superior completo ou cursando;
  • Pós-graduação ou Especialização será um diferencial;
  • Experiência em atendimento a clientes PJ/empresas;
  • Vale-Refeição;
  • Vale-Alimentação;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Convênio com o Gympass e Totalpass;
  • Convênio com a Univers (Drogasil e Droga Raia);
  • Visitas, reservas e hospedagem no Itaú Unibanco Clube (Guarapiranga, Itanhaém e São Sebastião);
  • Programa IUPP (vantagens e descontos em lojas e serviços de diversos parceiros no Brasil e na América Latina);
  • Universidade Corporativa;
  • Descontos em produtos e serviços financeiros;
  • Muito mais!

Estamos em constante transformação e te esperamos para contribuir com essa jornada! #VemProItaú

O Itaú utilizará os dados fornecidos para fins de processos seletivos, inclusive em bancos de vagas alocados em plataformas terceiras. Caso deseje solicitar oposição a este uso, ou exercer quaisquer um dos seus direitos, entre em contato através de nossos canais, disponíveis na Política de Privacidade de candidatos do Itaú Unibanco ( ). Não há necessidade de aceitar, trata-se apenas de uma ciência.

Somos o maior banco privado brasileiro em valor de mercado e a marca mais valiosa do Brasil , avaliada em R$ 46,9 bilhões segundo o ranking Interbrand 2024, também somos a empresa que mais desenvolve carreiras no Brasil , segundo o LinkedIn Top Companies há 7 anos consecutivos, além de termos recebido o prémio de melhores programas de estágio 2024 pelo CIEE.

Com a maior prateleira de produtos do setor no país e por meio de nossas marcas e parcerias comerciais, oferecemos um amplo leque de oportunidades de carreira em diversas áreas de especialização , tudo com um grande propósito – encantar os nossos clientes, entregando o que eles precisam na hora que eles precisam!

Hoje contamos com um time de 96,2 mil colaboradores (os itubers) espalhados pelo Brasil e exterior, em que estamos presentes em 18 países.

description:

Salário A combinar

A SolMirandaRH em parceria com Condomínio Residencial, contrata: Supervisor Operacional de Condomínio. Salário + benefícios. Escala 12x36 - diurno.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar e supervisionar as equipes de portaria, limpeza, manutenção, segurança e outros prestadores de serviço.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das escalas de trabalho e monitorar o desempenho das equipes.
  • Realizar treinamentos e orientar os colaboradores sobre as normas internas e padrões de qualidade.
  • Acompanhar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos e sistemas do condomínio.
  • Inspecionar regularmente as áreas comuns para identificar possíveis problemas e sugerir soluções.
  • Solicitar e acompanhar os serviços de fornecedores terceirizados relacionados à infraestrutura.
  • Garantir a organização e o funcionamento adequado das áreas comuns do condomínio.
  • Propor melhorias operacionais para aumentar a eficiência e reduzir custos.
  • Atender demandas, reclamações ou sugestões de moradores e usuários, fornecendo feedbacks ou encaminhando soluções.
  • Servir de ponte entre o síndico, administradora e as equipes operacionais.
  • Garantir boa comunicação entre os colaboradores e as partes envolvidas no condomínio.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento do regulamento interno por moradores e colaboradores.
  • Garantir que todas as operações estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e legislação aplicável.
  • Elaborar relatórios periódicos sobre o andamento das atividades e condições do condomínio para o síndico ou administradora.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho operacional e sugerir melhorias.

Requisitos

  • Cursando nível superior.
  • Experiência prévia na supervisão de operações em condomínios ou áreas semelhantes.
  • Conhecimento básico de manutenção predial (elétrica, hidráulica, ar condicionado, etc.).
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão e tomar decisões rápidas.
  • Desejável curso ou treinamento em administração condominial ou áreas correlatas.

Habilidades

  • Capacidade de gerenciar e motivar equipes.
  • Habilidade para coordenar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente.
  • Clareza no diálogo com moradores, equipes e fornecedores.
  • Antecipação de problemas e busca de soluções práticas.

title: Financial Applications Director
description:
Overview

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

Responsibilities

  • Systems Support
  • Responsible for all aspects of end-user support for financial systems, including:
    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.
  • Serve as the Business World applications ‘go-to’ person by researching software functionality, staying current on technology changes, and advising on best practices.
  • Test patches to ensure that they resolve issues as intended. Work with systems software vendors and CI’s IT department to facilitate the migration of patches to production that have passed testing. Create/maintain system configuration as needed to ensure optimal processing.
  • Maintain and manage relationships with financial systems, software, and service vendors to ensure strong working relationships, maximized levels of support, and efficient use of CI’s resources.
  • Documentation and Training
  • Develop and maintain financial systems SharePoint resource site(s) with relevant help materials for end users.
  • Draft and update financial systems user and administrative procedures as needed.
  • Conduct training for end users as required.
  • Project Management/Change Management
  • Manage financial systems team meetings. Coordinate with business process owners, super users, and other team members as needed to ensure good communication on all financial system-related issues.
  • Manage the change management system to ensure all changes to production financial systems are properly documented, approved, tested, and implemented.

Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions

  • Normal office environment.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 7 or more years of related experience.
  • 2 or more years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Applications, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Contract Accounting, Operating Budget, Project Management, and Procurement modules.
  • Solid working knowledge of database architecture and management
  • SQL Server and Visual Basic experience
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools
  • Project management skills.
  • Ability to adapt and work effectively with functional teams across the organization.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Experience in training on software applications.
  • Preferred
  • Administrator experience using Unit4 Business World
  • Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, and/or French

To apply for this position please submit a resume and cover letter.

title: Head of Engineering (Payments)
description:
Overview

Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians! At RecargaPay, we're on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs. We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We've been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market. Our goal is to deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike. We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action and are looking for curious, hands-on people who want to solve real problems and rethink what’s possible. If you're ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and scale a team of engineers, promoting a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Remain actively involved in system architecture decisions and complex problem-solving
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment between business goals and technology execution
  • Define and drive engineering best practices across development, testing, deployment, and observability
  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders, fostering career growth and technical development
  • Participate in technical hiring and shape team structure and engineering processes
  • Promote AI-assisted engineering practices within squads and chapters, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation
  • Guide conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration
  • Define and drive the tribe’s technical vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives
  • Partner with Squad Leaders and Product counterparts to shape roadmaps, identify trade-offs, and prioritize delivery
  • Mentor and develop Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Tech Leads
  • Promote high standards in software architecture, observability, reliability, and scalability
  • Ensure teams are resourced, structured, and supported to deliver value with speed and quality
  • Contribute to talent strategy: hiring, succession planning, career development, and performance management of engineering leadership
  • Serve as the primary interface between engineering and the Tribe Lead, supporting delivery accountability and risk management
  • Collaborate with the VP of Engineering and other Heads of Engineering to uphold chapter-wide standards
  • Guide architectural decisions and governance, facilitating technical forums and peer reviews at tribe level
  • Champion AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, maintainability, and code quality
  • Establish and monitor key technical KPIs (reliability, velocity, tech debt, performance) across squads
  • Lead by example in cultivating an inclusive, empowering engineering culture rooted in ownership, impact, and continuous learning

Requirements

  • Academic background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related disciplines
  • Extensive experience in senior engineering leadership roles within product-centric technology companies
  • Strong expertise in Java and Spring Boot, with knowledge of relational databases, data modeling, and insights via reporting tools and dashboards
  • Experience designing and operating distributed systems and working with AWS
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and microservices
  • Understanding of software architecture, clean code, and scalability in high-throughput or fintech/regulatory environments
  • Knowledge of modern software quality practices, including automated testing, code reviews, observability, and performance optimization
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (code generation, test automation, documentation)
  • Proven ability to lead and scale engineering teams across multiple squads
  • Experience managing Engineering Managers and building layered leadership structures
  • Ability to define and track team OKRs and technical KPIs aligned with company goals
  • Skilled at evaluating and prioritizing technical initiatives based on business impact
  • Experience managing engineering budgets, tooling investments, and infrastructure resources
  • Strong communication skills to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven ability to partner with cross-functional leaders from Product, Design, Business, and Operations
  • Ability to drive collaboration across squads and departments to align technical direction with product goals
  • Comfortable in dynamic, fast-paced environments, leading through influence and technical credibility
  • Track record of hiring, mentoring, and developing engineering talent, including leaders and managers
  • Committed to inclusive, psychologically safe, and growth-oriented teams
  • Experience driving knowledge sharing and engineering best practices across teams

Industry-Specific Knowledge

As Head of Engineering, you bring deep, hands-on familiarity with core financial domains such as lending, payments, credit, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand regulatory constraints and business drivers. You will align engineering execution with product strategy and work with Squad Leaders, Product Managers, and Tribe leadership to define roadmaps and guide decision-making that balances delivery velocity, platform health, and business value. You will oversee multiple engineering teams across the tribe and translate domain needs into actionable technical direction.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary
  • Annual Award Program
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you are part of the team
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay
  • Life insurance
  • Flexible meal allowance
  • TotalPass membership for health
  • Language classes

Diversity & Inclusion

We value diverse perspectives and experiences. Everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and do not discriminate on gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic.

About The Use Of Your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Resumo

O(a) Gerente de Testes será responsável por liderar as atividades de planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de testes funcionais e integrados em ambientes SAP e sistemas corporativos relacionados. Este profissional atuará de forma estratégica, garantindo a qualidade das entregas, a aderência às metodologias de teste e o cumprimento dos prazos do projeto. Além disso, será responsável por gerir equipes multidisciplinares, reportar status a executivos e garantir o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio, TI e fornecedores.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e coordenar todas as fases do ciclo de testes (unitário, integração, regressão, aceitação do usuário).
  • Elaborar e revisar estratégias, planos e cronogramas de teste.
  • Monitorar o andamento dos testes e execução de scripts, garantindo cobertura adequada dos requisitos.
  • Gerir a equipe de testes (internos e terceiros), distribuindo atividades e acompanhando performance.
  • Utilizar e administrar ferramentas ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) para controle de casos de teste, defeitos e indicadores de qualidade.
  • Gerar relatórios de progresso e métricas de qualidade para stakeholders e gestão executiva.
  • Coordenar atividades de testes em ambientes SAP, assegurando a integração entre módulos e sistemas legados.
  • Garantir que todas as entregas estejam em conformidade com os padrões de qualidade e governança definidos pelo projeto.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos na área de testes, sendo pelo menos 2 anos em gestão de testes ou liderança técnica.
  • Conhecimento sólido em planejamento, execução e acompanhamento de testes.
  • Domínio de ferramentas ALM (ex: HP ALM / Micro Focus ALM, Jira + Xray, Azure DevOps).
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes SAP (ECC ou S/4HANA).
  • Inglês avançado (capaz de conduzir reuniões e redigir relatórios técnicos).
  • Necessário disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Desejáveis

  • Experiência em projetos de implementação, rollout ou upgrade SAP.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe).
  • Certificações ISTQB, PMP ou similares.
  • Vivência em ambientes multinacionais.

Benefícios

  • Cartão ECXPAY no valor de R$ 500,00/mês para despesas operacionais;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub como cortesia empresarial;
  • Parceria com Zenklub - serviços de bem-estar (Psicólogo/Nutricionista/Coaching/Terapia);
  • 22 dias de suspensão remunerada dos serviços por ano, após 12 meses de parceria;

title: GERENTE MANUTENCAO
description:
Visão geral

Você já conhece a ZAMP (Burger King / Popeyes / Starbucks / Subway)?

ZAMP® é mais do que uma operadora de restaurantes, nós somos uma comunidade que celebra a diversidade e a autenticidade. Nossas marcas globalmente reconhecidas são sinônimo de sabor e descoberta. Com mais de 1000 restaurantes espalhados pelo Brasil e uma equipe de 15 mil colaboradores, nosso sonho é ser a melhor operadora de marcas de restaurantes do mundo.

Inclusão é o nosso ingrediente secreto: Na ZAMP®, valorizamos cada indivíduo e promovemos uma cultura onde todas as pessoas são bem‑vindas, portanto, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência e talentos de todas as esferas sociais.

Junte-se a nós nessa jornada, onde cada momento é uma celebração e cada desafio é uma oportunidade para transformar positivamente a vida das pessoas. Vamos juntos fazer o que é certo e construir um futuro onde todos têm lugar à mesa!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Essa posição vai gerir todas as regionais fora de SP, portanto é necessário residir preferencialmente no Nordeste, Minas Gerais ou Rio de Janeiro, ou ter disponibilidade de mudança.

Responsável pelo planejamento e gestão da manutenção de equipamentos e conservação de ativos de toda operação BK Brasil, visando garantir a disponibilidade de equipamentos e ativos.

  • Garantir que os equipamentos dos restaurantes estejam disponíveis para operação, por meio de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.
  • Controlar os custos de manutenção para que fiquem dentro do orçado, mediante planejamento e controle de gastos.
  • Executar projetos de investimento (CAPEX) de fim de vida útil / peças para renovação do parque de equipamentos, mediante troca de equipamentos / componentes obsoletos, por novos.
  • Executar projetos de investimento (CAPEX) de infra estrutura / adequações e projetos especiais para realizar as melhorias estruturais, adequações e implantação de novas tecnologias.
  • Garantir a conservação predial e infraestrutura dos restaurantes, por meio de planejamento e execução das rotinas de conservação.
  • Controlar os ativos (equipamentos), por meio de auditoria em campo e gestão em sistema.
  • Garantir a maior disponibilidade de equipamentos tendo o menor custo possível.
  • Garantir um padrão de SLA em todas as regiões geográficas de atuação.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia ou área correlatas.
  • Conhecimento em elétrica, mecânica, manutenção de equipamentos.
  • Experiência com manutenção de equipamentos, planejamento e organização, supervisão de equipes, gestão de fornecedores, execução de manutenção.
  • Habilidades sólidas de liderança, resolução de conflitos e boa comunicação.
  • Pacote Office Avançado.

Benefícios

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação.
  • Cartão Multibenefícios.
  • Vale‑transporte, estacionamento ou fretado.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico sem coparticipação (inclusive para dependentes).
  • Seguro de Vida (desde o 1º dia de admissão).
  • Bônus Atrativo Anual.
  • Parceria com universidades e instituições de ensino.
  • Programas de saúde e bem‑estar (telemedicina e psicoterapia online).
  • TotalPass (plataforma que oferece acesso a mais de 20 mil academias e parceiros de psicologia, nutrição e bem‑estar em um só benefício).

Zamp, um ecossistema de restaurantes e pessoas em constante evolução. Somos um grande ecossistema de restaurantes que reúne marcas internacionais como Burger King®, Popeyes®, Starbucks® e Subway®. E, por trás de cada receita de sucesso, estão os Zampers: gente que faz acontecer, que joga junto e que deixa sua marca todos os dias. Aqui, a gente acredita que o verdadeiro sabor do sucesso é ter espaço pra criar, crescer, liderar e ser quem você é. Usamos tecnologia, inovação e muita parceria para entregar experiências que surpreendem nossos clientes e geram oportunidades para o nosso time. Temos apetite pelo futuro e ousadia para conquistar novos mercados, novos sabores e novas conexões. Porque grandes marcas só existem quando grandes pessoas constroem algo maior do que elas mesmas.

fast, seamless, and borderless. Our proprietary Property Management System (PMS) is redefining how people live and landlords operate — removing friction, reducing fees, and unlocking global mobility. You’ll help shape priorities, turn ideas into execution, and ensure the entire organization moves in sync as The Flex scales globally.   • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Act as the connective tissue between teams — ensuring communication, momentum, and alignment.

  • High-impact partnership. Work directly with the Founder/CEO on mission-critical projects.

Do Not Apply If



  • You want a predictable 9–5 routine.

  • You’re not committed to becoming elite in your craft.


About The Flex (cont.)
